A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the chiral power counting of relativistic baryons is consistent and well defined.

the nucleon mass is not protected by chiral symmetry and the chiral expansion is not a systematic expansion for the nucleon mass, but it is a systematic expansion for a variety of other physical quantities.
the nucleon mass is well reproduced by the chiral expansion and the scalar form factor is well described by the leading order chiral expansion.

the renormalized diagrams in the effective Lagrangian are finite and the power counting is consistent with the standard counting of chiral perturbative diagrams.
